rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.

rules.official_behavior: Save uses AND, so a partially populated date bypasses this guard; it performs no calendar/future-date checks.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require all date components and apply the same full date validation used by Validate.
